criteria.requirement: Add exported Lag and Lead Computation classes with (column_name, offset=1, default=None, partition_by=None). Use existing row order, including interleaved partitions, without sorting or mutating the table. Offset must be a nonnegative non-bool integer; zero copies the original column. partition_by accepts a column name or finite unique list/tuple of column names. Validate names and cast the boundary default with the original DataType; return a column of that same type and original length. Nulls remain positional values and oversized offsets fill the default. Preserve existing Change and other computations.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
